Paige Cognetti, Oregon, Harvard, D.C. Wall Street.
Rob Bresnahan never left these nine miles.
Always a hard working kid.
I taught him in eighth grade.
I taught him in fifth.

Northeastern Pennsylvania is where we met and where we'll stay.
Because to us, it's everything.
I'm Rob Bresnahan and I approve this message.
I'll never forget where I came from because I never left.
